description: This file contains functions, types, and constants related to block streaming configuration, including chunking and coalescing logic, for an auto-reply system in a messaging platform.

methods.name: normalizeChunkProvider
methods.description: Normalizes a provider string into a TextChunkProvider object if possible.

methods.name: resolveProviderChunkContext
methods.description: Resolves context information for a provider, including provider key, ID, and text limit.

methods.name: resolveProviderBlockStreamingCoalesce
methods.description: Resolves block coalescing configuration for a given provider and account.

methods.name: clampPositiveInteger
methods.description: Clamps a number to a specified range, with fallback for invalid input.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveBlockStreamingConfig
methods.description: Computes effective chunking and coalescing configurations based on provided parameters and defaults.

methods.name: resolveBlockStreamingChunking
methods.description: Determines chunking parameters for block streaming based on configuration and context.

methods.name: resolveBlockStreamingCoalescing
methods.description: Determines coalescing parameters for block streaming based on configuration and context.
